verdict.rationale: Featurebase has an API reference, SDK, and webhooks (featurebase-docs-1/2, featurebase-probe-1), showing some programmatic access exists, but there is no evidence of full UI/API parity — no documentation claiming all UI actions (e.g., AI triage, changelog customization, integrations setup) are exposed via API, and the OpenAPI spec could not be located at standard paths. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, working OpenAPI spec discovery, coverage of AI-agent/Fibi actions via API, and independent confirmation of completeness.
